warnings.message: Use 营业收入 170899152276.34 with 营业成本 for the nonfinancial business margin. Do not silently substitute 营业总收入 174144069958.25, which additionally includes the financial subsidiary's 3244917681.91 interest revenue. The alcohol 主营业务收入 is a third basis: 170611838052.02 (report p9/p108).

Management attributes CFO growth partly to the finance subsidiary collecting more funds from other group members. Consolidated CFO is not pure liquor-business customer cash conversion. Report p12 also shows 客户存款和同业存放款项净增加额 11060205782.10 in 2024 versus -810223002.76 in 2023. Do not create an adjusted CFO by subtracting only one line; finance-company cash-flow structure needs a separate reconciliation.

There are separate financial-subsidiary interest costs and interest expense within 财务费用. A generic screener cannot treat negative net 财务费用 as gross interest expense; require explicit interest_cost definition before computing interest coverage.

company_disclosed_profit_ex_oneoff_equit.basis: Company's narrow adjustment to the 2023 comparator only; not PRC statutory 扣非 and not a unified core-profit definition.

warnings.message: Keep net_profit_core missing for both years. The 2023 comparator adjustment removes one specific equity-method non-operating gain; the report does not disclose a comparable 2024 A-share statutory core profit. Do not set net_profit_core equal to reported net_profit.

Zero year-end bank borrowings does not imply zero annual interest cost. The cash-flow statement shows RMB5.006216 billion of bank borrowing and equal repayments in 2024 and RMB28.176 million interest paid. Lease liabilities are also separate obligations; do not equate bank debt with all interest-bearing debt.

The financial statements were approved on 2025-03-27, audited results announced via HKEX on 2025-03-28, and the annual-report PDF source carries 2025-04-29. A future PIT dataset must distinguish these timestamps and retain the original version seen then.
